Package com.example.volt.commnad

Class DestinationSelectedCommand

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.commnad.DestinationSelectedCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command<Destination>
public class DestinationSelectedCommand extends Object implements Command<Destination>
DestinationSelectedCommand is a concrete Command that encapsulates the operations to perform when a Destination is selected.

Representation Invariant:

  • mapManager != null
  • popupManager != null

Abstraction Function:

DestinationSelectedCommand dsc represents a block of operations to execute when a Destination is selected such that:
  • dsc.mapManager is a MapManager to which we delegate map-related operations.
  • dsc.popupManager is a PopupManager to which we delegate popup-related operations.
